evals.prompt: Create a GitHub Actions CI pipeline for a Node.js project with npm caching, matrix testing across Node 18/20/22, and pinned action SHAs.
evals.expected_output: The agent generates a GitHub Actions workflow in .github/workflows/ci.yml with top-level permissions, 40-character SHA pinning, Node version matrix, and npm caching.
expectations: Workflow uses 40-character commit SHAs for third-party actions
Top-level permissions: read-all or explicit minimal permissions declared
Matrix testing strategy and dependency caching configured

evals.prompt: Configure an environment promotion deployment workflow using GitHub OIDC and environment protection gates.
evals.expected_output: The agent constructs staging and production deployment jobs with OIDC authentication, environment protection rules, and concurrency limits.
expectations: OIDC federated auth (id-token: write) used instead of hardcoded cloud keys
Environment protection rules configured for staging and production
Concurrency group set up to prevent simultaneous deployment races
